protocol.seed_aggregation: same resampled test units applied to both systems and all model seeds; bootstrap statistic is mean score difference across seeds

resampling_unit_policy.biblical: cluster bootstrap over usfm_code so aligned edition variants of the same underlying verse remain together
resampling_unit_policy.conversational: paired example-level bootstrap over example_index; the six dialogue clusters are retained for data splitting but are too few for a stable percentile cluster-bootstrap interval

protocol.seed_variability_policy: model-seed variability remains reported separately as mean±SD; E8 intervals quantify test-set resampling uncertainty
protocol.multiplicity_note: No exhaustive all-pairs architecture search is performed; only prespecified contrasts are generated.
